title: Bag of Bricks - Grass 28
descriptionHtml:
Grass — colour 28

A bright, fresh green with a yellow lean. Grass is spring lawns and new growth — the highlight green that sits on top of the darker shades and makes foliage look sunlit.

Works well with: Green 22, Spring Yellow 04, Dark Green 23

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Grass bricks (colour 28) for Memobrick mosaics. A bright fresh green for lawns, spring scenes and vivid natural detail. Resealable bag.
